title: 麥加—麥地那高速鐵路
summary: 以麥加至麥地那高速鐵路為背景，建立高溫、砂塵及集中旅客到達並存的教學案例。學徒把進氣過濾、散熱、供電和月台人流連結，在集中特殊需求下檢查系統瓶頸；所有人數與氣候數值均為自訂算例而非營運資料。
summaryEn: Use the Haramain high-speed corridor to frame a teaching case combining heat, airborne sand and concentrated passenger arrivals. Connect intake filtration, cooling, power supply and platform flow under exceptional demand. All passenger and weather numbers are invented exercises, and students must distinguish a bottleneck revealed by a model from a verified constraint on the actual railway.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期與濾網壓差與通風功率
stages.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval & Filter pressure drop and fan power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「砂塵沉積與清理週期」與「濾網壓差與通風功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dust deposition and cleaning interval" and "Filter pressure drop and fan power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「砂塵沉積與清理週期」如何影響麥加—麥地那高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉積質量可由有效集塵面積、入射質量通量與時間估算，防砂構造改變局部風場也會改變沉積位置。清理週期應依累積量與功能影響決定，而不是把全年平均濃度當成每次沙塵事件。 沉積通量乘接收面積與時間得到積砂質量，通量已是單位面積的到達率。它不同於空氣中的濃度；要從濃度推回沉積，還需風速、粒徑及捕集機制。 把地表沉積通量與設備接收面積連結，估算清理週期的積砂質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「砂塵沉積與清理週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deposited mass can be estimated from effective collection area, incident mass flux and time. Wind barriers alter local airflow and deposition location. Cleaning intervals should follow accumulation and functional impact rather than treating annual mean concentration as a description of every dust event. Deposition flux times receiving area and time gives accumulated sand mass. Flux is already an arrival rate per unit area and differs from airborne concentration. Deriving deposition from concentration also requires wind, particle size and a capture mechanism. Relate deposition flux to equipment receiving area and estimate sand mass over a cleaning interval. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s；計算：deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s; calculation: deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dust deposition and cleaning interval”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s；計算：deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg。敏感度：flux 單獨增加百分之十至 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s)，其餘固定，結果為 3.915648 kg。模型邊界：固定沉積通量與面積；不含再懸浮、顆粒分徑和風向變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: flux=8.24e-05 kg/(m^2*s); area=12 m^2; duration=3600 s; calculation: deposit=flux*area*duration=3.55968 kg. Sensitivity: flux, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 9.064e-05 kg/(m^2*s), with all other inputs fixed, gives 3.915648 kg. Model boundary: Fixed deposition flux and area; resuspension, particle-size distribution and changing wind direction are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dust deposition and cleaning interval: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「砂塵沉積與清理週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dust deposition and cleaning interval” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。 用已知面積收集盤在指定時間稱重，保留風向與取樣位置，並檢查再懸浮和散失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading. Weigh collection trays of known area over a stated interval, retain wind direction and sampling location, and inspect resuspension and losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較同總入砂量的均勻與集中沉積，設計清理頻率表，說明為何要保留風向與設備位置而不能只報總重量。 再以本單元 flux 的對照值重算 deposit，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare uniform and concentrated deposition at equal total input, design a cleaning-interval table, and explain why wind direction and equipment location matter beyond total mass. Also recalculate deposit for the alternative flux value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：防風牆可能把沉積集中到設備附近，清理不到的角落會比平均面積更快受堵；濕砂還可能附著於絕緣表面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wind barrier may concentrate deposits near equipment, inaccessible corners can clog faster than the mean, and wet dust can adhere to insulating surfaces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 砂塵沉積與清理週期：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「砂塵沉積與清理週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Haramain high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。 顯熱負載決定溫度改變需求，但高濕環境還有潛熱除濕與新風處理。冷卻量和耗電量也不同，兩者需要效率或性能係數連結，不能把熱量數字當作電表讀值。 分開乘客、設備和外氣顯熱，檢查尖峰冷房負載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風散熱與設備溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature. Equipment rooms also contain recirculation and hot spots, so an average supply-to-exhaust difference does not guarantee identical conditions around every electronic module. Sensible load describes temperature-related demand, while humidity introduces latent dehumidification and outdoor-air treatment. Cooling delivered and electricity consumed are different quantities, connected through efficiency or a performance coefficient rather than treated as identical meter readings. Separate passenger, equipment and outdoor-air sensible heat when checking peak cooling demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20394 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.09204 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20394 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.09204 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。 等效需求把攜行李旅客依宣告係數換算為普通旅客負荷，不是把人數真的增加。係數需對應車門交換、通道占用等指定用途，不能拿一個值同時代表所有服務時間。 以行李比例建立等效通道負荷，再與旅客實際人數分列。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行李旅客與等效交換需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes. Door width, level differences and travelling groups also alter passage time. Equivalent demand converts baggage travellers into ordinary-passenger load using a declared factor; it does not create additional people. The factor must correspond to a specified purpose such as door exchange or space occupation, not represent all service times simultaneously. Build equivalent passage load from baggage proportions and report it separately from actual headcount. knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6118.2 s，其餘固定，結果為 34 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6118.2 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 34 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「周轉時間與車隊需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip time and fleet size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「周轉時間與車隊需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Round-trip time and fleet size” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：依尖峰班距與完整循環時間估算上線車數和備用需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Estimate circulating trains and spare needs from peak headway and complete round-trip time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
